name: EPIC 211609805

text.card: A red giant 3,727 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.91 solar masses and 16.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,722 K at its surface.
